entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the VeloFit Spin Class Shoes, delivered 12 days ago. To get started, is the issue a technical fault with the shoes, or more of a personal preference?
I just don't like them. These cycling shoes gave me blisters after one ride.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I understand wanting to return them. Were there any issues with the cleats or just the fit of the shoe itself?
Just the fit. They're not for me.
Understood. Let me just review the return policy for this item. One moment please.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've confirmed that your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Fine. So what do I do?

I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file for you now. And because you are a VIP member, I've also added a $20 VeloFit credit to your account for the inconvenience. You can use that on any future purchase.
Okay. I guess that works. When will I get the refund?
The refund will be issued to your original form of payment as soon as our warehouse receives and inspects the package, which typically takes 3 to 5 business days from its arrival.
The email has been sent. Was there anything else I could help you with today, Sarah?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a wonderful rest of your day.
